text: Stake.com sits under Easygo, the Australian company built by co-founders Ed Craven and Bijan Tehrani. Forbes Australia reports that 'their company Easygo Solutions' reported a net profit to ASIC (Australia's corporate regulator) of $206 million for 2023, after paying $102 million in tax — private, founder-owned Australian capital, with no state or sovereign-fund owner identified in this source.

source.name: Forbes Australia: How Ed Craven and Bijan Tehrani built their $5.6 billion fortune
source.quote: Their company Easygo Solutions reports a net profit to ASIC of $206 million for 2023 after paying $102 million in tax.
